sentences.en: We stopped at the lookout points to admire the view.
sentences.zh: 我们在瞭望点停下来看风景。

sentences.en: The brochure mentioned several scenic lookout points along the trail.
sentences.zh: 手册上提到沿途有几个观景台。

sentences.en: Don't forget to check out the lookout points for sunset views.
sentences.zh: 别忘了去瞭望点看日落的景色。
